oil.when: 2008 using the Driver Information Center buttons or the trip odometer stem
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Bring up OIL LIFE REMAINING on the Driver Information Center. On a truck without DIC buttons, the truck must be in Park to show this reading.
Press and hold the SET/RESET button, or the trip odometer reset stem on trucks without DIC buttons, for more than five seconds.
Let go when the oil life reads 100%.
If CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON comes back when you start the truck, repeat the steps.

notes: Reset the oil life system after every oil change, including one done before the message came on, because it does not reset itself.
